description: Sanford, FL – Former Congresswoman and Orlando Chief of Police Val Demings announced her endorsement of Bale Dalton in Florida’s 7th Congressional District today, praising Dalton’s 24 years of military service and ability to bring together a winning coalition in November.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Dalton for Florida Bale Dalton is a former member of the United States Navy and current member of the United States Navy Reserve
title: Former Rep. Val Demings Endorses Bale Dalton - Bale Dalton
